verdict.rationale: Workflow Studio provides a no-code, drag-and-drop builder for verification workflows laid out like flow charts. Configurable webhook events notify you of workflow status changes, so your own systems can react automatically. However, the evidence never explicitly describes user-defined conditional rules that trigger actions on events. Event-driven automation therefore appears to rely on handling webhooks externally. Missing for 10: documented rule/condition logic (e.g., branching on report results), built-in automatic actions triggered by events, an event catalog, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
